title: 第六章 石上迹
content_zh:
铁骨草汁液带来的不适，在次日清晨的站桩中渐渐散去。陈默能感觉到，肩臂处昨日因练习体术残篇而产生的酸胀，似乎确实缓解得比往常快了些许。那感觉细微难辨，或许只是睡了一觉的缘故，但他宁可信其有。

    他依旧寅时三刻起身，冷水擦身，在熹微晨光中稳稳定住桩架。呼吸悠长，试图捕捉体内那缕若有若无的暖意。今日似乎比昨日更凝实了分毫，在胸口滞涩处盘桓的时间，也多了那么一两息。进步微乎其微，但日复一日的记录告诉他，变化确实在发生，像石头上缓慢累积的水痕。

    早饭后，陈默被赵胖子指派，去山下青云镇跑一趟腿，给镇上一家与宗门有往来的杂货铺送些新制的木炭样品，顺便取回铺子代收的几包货物。

    这是个相对轻松的活计，不必耗费太多体力，还能离开杂役院片刻，看看外头的天色。不少杂役都愿意接，通常轮不到陈默。今日不知是赵胖子心情好，还是别人都抽不开身，这差事竟落到了他头上。

    陈默领了对牌，背起一筐用油布盖好的上等木炭，出了杂役院侧门，沿着蜿蜒的山道往下走。山道是青石铺就，年头久了，被无数脚步磨得光滑，雨后湿漉漉的，有些地方生了青苔，踩上去需格外小心。

    春日山景，雨后初霁，空气里弥漫着泥土和草木的清新气息。远处山峦叠翠，云雾缭绕，偶有飞鸟掠过，留下一串清鸣。但对于每日埋头劳作的陈默而言，这景色并无多少闲情欣赏。他只是沉默地走着，步伐不快不慢，背上的木炭筐随着他的脚步微微晃动。

    走了约莫半个时辰，山势渐缓，人烟也稠密起来。道路两旁开始出现零星的茶棚、歇脚亭，还有一些简陋的屋舍。再往下，一片依山而建的镇子轮廓逐渐清晰，灰瓦白墙，鳞次栉比，正是青云镇。

    青云镇因青云宗得名，镇上居民多与宗门有些关联，或是外门弟子、杂役的亲属，或是做着与宗门相关的营生。街道不算宽阔，但颇为热闹，店铺林立，贩夫走卒吆喝声不绝于耳。空气中混杂着各种气味：刚出笼的包子香，铁匠铺传来的煤烟味，药铺飘散的苦涩，还有行人身上的汗味尘土气。

    陈默很少下山，对镇子并不熟悉。他按着赵胖子给的地址，穿过几条石板路，找到那家“刘记杂货”。铺子不大，门脸有些旧，柜台后坐着个精瘦的中年掌柜，正噼里啪啦打着算盘。

    陈默递上对牌，说明来意。刘掌柜验过对牌，看了看木炭成色，点点头，让伙计将炭搬进去，然后从柜台下取出几个用麻绳捆扎严实的布包，递给陈默。

    “这是宗门要的货，点清楚了，朱砂三包，硝石两包，还有一包是陈掌柜要的雨前茶。”刘掌柜声音干巴巴的，“回去路上当心，别磕了碰了，尤其是朱砂。”

    “是。”陈默应下，接过布包，入手沉甸甸的。他小心地将几个布包在带来的空筐里放好，用油布盖严实。

    事情办完，他本该立刻返回。但目光扫过街上熙攘的人流，听着隐约传来的、属于世俗的热闹声响，他脚步顿了顿。

    他摸了摸怀里。那里有他积攒的铜板，十七枚，沉甸甸地贴在心口。五个铜板能买块像样的磨刀石，也能在镇上的小摊，买两个热腾腾的肉包子，或者一碗撒了葱花的阳春面。那是他大半年没尝过的滋味。

    喉结微微动了动。但他最终只是紧了紧衣襟，转身，准备循原路返回。

    就在这时，街角一阵喧哗吸引了他的注意。

    一群人围成了一个圈子，隐约有争执声传来。陈默本不欲多事，但那人群中，似乎有几个穿着青云宗外门弟子服饰的青色身影。他脚步不由慢了下来，隔着一段距离望去。

    只见圈子里，是三个十七八岁的青衣少年，正是青云宗外门弟子。他们围着一个看起来更小些的、穿着粗布衣裳的女孩。女孩约莫十三四岁年纪，身形瘦小，头发枯黄，用一根木簪草草绾着，脸上沾着些灰土，看不清容貌。她怀里紧紧抱着一个破旧的竹篮，篮子里似乎装着些山货，有蘑菇，有野菜，还有几把用草茎捆着的、颜色暗淡的草药。

    “……说了这‘雾灵菇’品相太次，灵气都快散尽了，最多值五个铜板！”一个身形微胖的外门弟子撇着嘴，用脚尖踢了踢女孩脚边的竹篮。

    “可……可王师兄说，上次这样的，他给了八个铜板。”女孩声音细细的，带着怯意，但抱着竹篮的手更紧了。

    “王师兄是王师兄，我们是我们！”另一个高个弟子不耐烦道，“就五个，爱卖不卖！不卖赶紧滚，别挡道！”

    “就是，一个连灵根都没有的野丫头，采点破烂也敢讨价还价？”微胖弟子嗤笑，“知道什么是灵气吗？你这蘑菇都快成干柴了！”

    女孩低着头，瘦弱的肩膀微微发抖，但抱着篮子的手却没松开。周围看热闹的人指指点点，有摇头的，有叹气的，却没人上前。

    陈默站在人群外围，静静看着。他认得那种“雾灵菇”，在周安执事的笔记上有简略提及，是青云山外围一种最低阶的灵菇，对低阶修士稳固心神、辅助入定有微乎其微的效用，通常生长在晨雾弥漫的潮湿林地。笔记上说，品相完好的，在坊市能值一两块碎灵石，也就是十来个铜板。女孩篮子里那些，确实有些干瘪，灵气流失不少，但五个铜板，也压得太低了。

    但他没有动。他只是一个杂役，穿着比那女孩好不了多少的粗布衣服，背着个破筐。那三个是外门弟子，哪怕只是炼气一二层，也不是他能招惹的。多管闲事，只会给自己带来麻烦。

    他移开目光，准备离开。

    就在这时，那高个弟子似乎被女孩的沉默激怒了，伸手就要去夺她怀里的竹篮：“磨磨唧唧的，拿来吧你！”

    女孩惊叫一声，死死抱住篮子，向后踉跄退去，脚下被不平的石板一绊，整个人向后摔倒。

    竹篮脱手飞出，里面的山货野菜撒了一地，那几个品相本就欠佳的雾灵菇滚落在泥尘里。

    三个外门弟子哄笑起来。

    女孩跌坐在地上，看着滚落的蘑菇和野菜，眼圈迅速红了，却咬着嘴唇，没哭出声。她挣扎着要爬起来去捡。
content_en:
The discomfort caused by the sap of the Iron Bone Grass gradually dissipated during the standing posture the next morning.Chen Mo could feel that the soreness and swelling in his shoulders and arms caused by practicing the remaining pieces of physical skills yesterday seemed to have relieved a little faster than usual.The feeling was subtle and difficult to distinguish, maybe it was just because of a long sleep, but he would rather believe it.
He still got up at three o'clock, wiped his body with cold water, and stabilized the stake in the faint morning light.He took a long breath, trying to catch the vague warmth in his body.Today seems to be a little more solid than yesterday, and the time lingering in the stagnation in the chest has been a breath or two longer.The progress was minimal, but day after day records told him that changes were indeed happening, like the slowly accumulated traces of water on a stone.
After breakfast, Chen Mo was assigned by Fatty Zhao to go to Qingyun Town at the foot of the mountain to deliver some newly made charcoal samples to a grocery store in the town that had dealings with the sect, and to pick up a few packages of goods collected by the shop.
This is a relatively easy job that doesn't require too much physical effort. You can also leave the yard for a while and look at the sky outside.Many handymen are willing to take the job, but Chen Mo usually doesn't get it.Today, I don't know whether Fatty Zhao was in a good mood or because no one else could get away, but this job actually fell on him.
Chen Mo received the pair of cards, carried a basket of fine charcoal covered with oilcloth, walked out of the side door of the courtyard, and walked down the winding mountain road.The mountain path is paved with bluestone, which has been worn smooth by countless footsteps over the years. It is wet after the rain, and moss has grown in some places. You need to be extra careful when stepping on it.
It's a spring mountain scene, just after the rain, the air is filled with the fresh smell of soil and vegetation.In the distance, there are mountains and green mountains, shrouded in clouds and mist, and occasionally birds passing by, leaving behind a string of clear calls.But for Chen Mo, who works hard every day, there is not much leisurely appreciation of this scenery.He just walked silently, neither fast nor slow, and the charcoal basket on his back swayed slightly with his steps.
After walking for about half an hour, the mountains gradually eased and the crowds became denser.Scattered tea sheds, resting pavilions, and some simple houses began to appear on both sides of the road.Further down, the outline of a town built on the mountain gradually becomes clearer, with gray tiles and white walls, row upon row, which is Qingyun Town.
Qingyun Town was named after the Qingyun Sect. Most of the residents in the town were related to the sect, either as outer disciples, relatives of handymen, or working in jobs related to the sect.The street is not wide, but it is quite lively, with many shops and the constant shouting of vendors and footmen.The air is mixed with various smells: the smell of freshly baked buns, the smell of coal smoke from the blacksmith shop, the bitterness from the medicine shop, and the smell of sweat and dust from pedestrians.
Chen Mo rarely goes down the mountain and is not familiar with the town.Following the address given by Fatty Zhao, he walked through several stone roads and found the "Liu Ji Grocery Store".The shop is not big, and the front is a bit old. There is a lean middle-aged shopkeeper sitting behind the counter, thinking hard.
Chen Mo handed over the pair of cards and explained his intention.Shopkeeper Liu checked the cards and looked at the quality of the charcoal. He nodded and asked the waiter to move the charcoal in. Then he took out several cloth bags tied tightly with hemp rope from under the counter and handed them to Chen Mo.
"This is what the sect wants. I ordered it clearly. Three packs of cinnabar, two packs of saltpeter, and one pack of Yuqian tea that shopkeeper Chen asked for." Shopkeeper Liu said in a dry voice, "Be careful not to touch the cinnabar on the way back. Especially the cinnabar."
"Yes." Chen Mo agreed, took the cloth bag, and held it heavily.He carefully wrapped several cloths in the empty basket he brought and put them away, covering them tightly with oilcloth.
After the matter was done, he should have returned immediately.But his eyes swept across the bustling crowd on the street, and he paused when he heard the vague, mundane sounds of excitement.
He touched his arms.There were seventeen copper coins that he had accumulated, heavy on his heart.Five copper coins can buy a decent sharpening stone, or you can buy two hot meat buns or a bowl of Yangchun noodles sprinkled with chopped green onion at a stall in the town.It was a taste he hadn't tasted in half a year.
The Adam's apple moved slightly.But in the end, he just tightened his clothes, turned around, and prepared to return the same way.
Just then, a commotion on the street corner attracted his attention.
A group of people formed a circle, and there were faint sounds of arguing.Chen Mo didn't want to get into trouble, but among the crowd, there seemed to be a few cyan figures wearing the clothes of Qingyun Sect's outer disciples.He couldn't help but slow down and looked from a distance.
In the circle, there were three young men in green clothes who were 17 or 18 years old, and they were the outer disciples of Qingyun Sect.They gathered around a smaller-looking girl wearing coarse clothes.The girl is about thirteen or fourteen years old. She is thin and has yellow hair tied hastily with a wooden hairpin. There is some dust on her face and her appearance cannot be seen clearly.She held an old bamboo basket tightly in her arms. The basket seemed to contain some mountain products, including mushrooms, wild vegetables, and a few handfuls of dim-colored herbs tied with straw stems.
"...I said that the quality of this 'Mist Mushroom' was too bad, and the spiritual energy is almost gone. It is worth five copper coins at most!" A fat outer disciple curled his lips and kicked the bamboo basket at the girl's feet with his toes.
"But...but Senior Brother Wang said that the last time this happened, he gave eight copper coins." The girl's voice was thin and timid, but her hands holding the bamboo basket tightened.
"Senior Brother Wang is Senior Brother Wang, and we are us!" Another tall disciple said impatiently, "Only five, sell them if you like! If not, get out of here and don't block the way!"
"You mean, a wild girl who doesn't even have spiritual roots dares to bargain for some rags?" The fat disciple sneered, "Do you know what spiritual energy is? Your mushrooms are almost like dry firewood!"
The girl lowered her head, her thin shoulders trembling slightly, but her hand holding the basket did not let go.The people watching around were pointing, some shaking their heads, some sighing, but no one came forward.
Chen Mo stood outside the crowd and watched quietly.He recognized the "fog spirit mushroom", which was briefly mentioned in Deacon Zhou An's notes. It was the lowest level spirit mushroom on the outskirts of Qingyun Mountain. It had little effect on low-level monks to stabilize their minds and help them enter concentration. It usually grew in moist woodlands filled with morning mist.The notes said that if it was in good condition, it would be worth one or two broken spiritual stones in the market, which is about ten copper plates.The ones in the girl's basket are indeed a little shriveled and have lost a lot of spiritual energy, but five copper coins are too low.
But he didn't move.He was just a handyman, wearing coarse cloth clothes not much better than the girl, and carrying a broken basket on his back.Those three were outer disciples, even if they were only on the first or second level of Qi Refining, they were not someone he could provoke.Being nosy will only bring you trouble.
He looked away and prepared to leave.
At this moment, the tall disciple seemed to be irritated by the girl's silence, and reached out to grab the bamboo basket in her arms: "Grudge, bring it here!"
The girl screamed, hugged the basket tightly, staggered back, tripped on an uneven stone slab, and fell backwards.
The bamboo basket flew out, and the wild vegetables inside were scattered all over the floor. The few mist mushrooms that were not in good condition rolled into the dust.
The three outer disciples burst into laughter.
The girl fell to the ground and looked at the falling mushrooms and wild vegetables. Her eye circles quickly turned red, but she bit her lip and did not cry.She struggled to get up and pick it up.
